hook_line: SECOND JUDGE BLOCKS BIRTHRIGHT CITIZENSHIP ORDER

hook_stat.sub: Amendment citizenship clause at the centre of the birthright ruling

stats.label: United States v. Wong Kim Ark decision on birthright citizenship
Executive Order signed by President Trump in August
Federal agencies barred from enforcing the order against the class

diaspora_bullets: US-born children in the covered categories remain citizens while the case proceeds
Nothing changes at the hospital or the passport office for now
news_summary: US District Judge Christopher Cooper in Washington, DC, issued a preliminary injunction blocking President Trump's August executive order narrowing birthright citizenship, the second court to block it.
payoff: The administration must win reversals of both injunctions before the order could ever take effect.
